title: iPhone held by user-try, unused for 5 min while 2 jobs wait

messages.text:
user-try has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 13:07Z, lease taken by user-try). The limit is 5 min.
Queued for it: fix-toolbar-resize.
Waiting on the status board: hero-exit-threaded (owner fix-hero-exit-threaded; its wait names the phone).
user-try: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner user-try) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).
Not a problem: this is your own hand test of PR-018 (T-120), so no robot runs are expected while you hold the phone. Ignore this alert; I'm fixing the alarm so it skips your own phone time.
Thanks, got it: the phone goes back to the robot tests now. Your PR-018 choice goes on the Proposals page whenever you're ready.
